name: Magical Girl Disorder
source:
Neo-Rennes, 2022.

As a former magical girl, your job was to guide the next generation.

You were supposed to train these five young women to fight evil, to embody justice, to overcome their fears.

And you failed.

A gigantic monster, more hideous and repulsive than anything you ever fought, is on the verge of destroying Neo-Rennes.

And your team isn't fighting.

Some of your protégés are scared. Some others want to watch the world burn.

But it doesn't matter: if you keep doing nothing, Neo-Rennes and its five million inhabitants will be erased from the surface of the Earth.

You have two hours to convince the girls to fight.

[From in-game intro]
